blocks.text: Love, Bonito opened its first regional store in Cebu at SM Seaside City Cebu on September 11, 2026 marking the Singapore-born womenswear brand’s first step outside Luzon in the Philippines. Led by Co-Founder Rachel Lim and CEO Dione Song, the opening responds to growing demand from Cebuano customers who have supported the brand online while bringing its focus on functional, well-fitting clothing for Asian women closer to the Queen City of the South.
